question.text: Grameen Urja, a Section 8 NPO, has listed ZCZPs for a rural solar-lighting program and also runs a separate NON-listed skilling program. Ms. Priya Shah, SIA, is advising on AIR preparation. Which statement is accurate under Regulation 91E?

answer.text: Both the solar program and the skilling program require external SIA assessment.
The solar program requires external SIA assessment; the skilling program is self-certified by Grameen Urja.
The solar program is self-certified; the skilling program requires external SIA assessment.
Neither program requires external SIA assessment because only listed-equity issuers are covered by Regulation 91E.

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 91E requires external assessment of the Annual Impact Report by a Social Impact Assessment Organization employing Social Impact Assessor(s) for LISTED projects. Projects that are not listed on the Social Stock Exchange are self-certified by the Social Enterprise. So Grameen Urja's listed ZCZP solar program needs SIA assessment while the non-listed skilling program is self-certified. The Trap: Options A and C either over-apply or invert the listed/non-listed split. Option D ignores that the workbook expressly treats Section 8 entities as NPOs and brings them within the listed/non-listed AIR framework. Note: The trigger for external SIA assessment is whether the project's instrument is listed on the Social Stock Exchange, not the legal form of the Social Enterprise.
